question_text: Which of the following is equal to 1000 (base 2)?
If y = 23 (base 5) + 101 (base 3), find y in base 2
explanation: 23 base 5 = 13 base 10; 101 base 3 = 10 base 10. Sum = 23 base 10 = 10111 base 2.
34 base 5 = 19 base 10; 54 base 6 = 34 base 10. X = 34-19 = 15 base 10.
2434 base 6 = 586 base 10; 42 base 6 = 26 base 10. 586/26 = 22.5. Check by direct base 6 division: 35 base 6 = 23 base 10. 23 x 26 = 598 = 2434 base 6.
